basic_details.job_title: LBS Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

age_limit.details: Note: OBC certificate (Delhi) issued from Govt. NCT of Delhi only will be considered.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior resident: MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognized University/Institute and must possess DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty. The tenure of the PG Degree/DNB/Diploma or post Doctoral Degree or equivalent should be completed as well as the result should be declared before the date of interview. If candidates with MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree or equivalent are not available then candidate with MBBS degree with 2 (Two) Years experience in the same specialty can be considered.

salary_details.details: Other admissible allowances per month as per 7th CPC.

selection_process: Mode of selection will be through interview only. Selection list will be prepared on a daily basis subject to availability of suitable/eligible candidates.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria for the Senior Resident position as per the official notification.
Gather original and self-attested photocopies of all required certificates and documents.
Affix two passport size photographs on the application form.
Report for the walk-in interview between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM at the Administration Branch, LBS Hospital.
Submit the application and attend the interview on the scheduled date.
important_instructions: The tenure of Senior Residents will be for a period of 44 days, which can be extended for further 44 days by giving 01 day break after receiving written request from the concerned doctor which is duly recommended and forwarded by the concerned in-charge till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier (maximum 03 years including any service rendered as Senior Residents earlier on ad-hoc/regular basis). In case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate reveals that the claim to belong to these categories is fake/false, services will be terminated forthwith. OBC/EWS certificate issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted and must have been issued before the date of interview. In case of non-availability of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, the post shall be filled from any other suitable candidate of unreserved/other category. The contract of appointment can be terminated by either party by giving a notice of seven days without assigning any reason. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates called for the interview. Selected candidates must submit an undertaking that he/she is not working at any Government or private health care facility at the time of joining and will not work during tenure.

In case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate reveals that the claim to belong to these categories is fake/false, services will be terminated forthwith. OBC/EWS certificate issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted and must have been issued before the date of interview. In case of non-availability of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, the post shall be filled from any other suitable candidate of unreserved/other category. The contract of appointment can be terminated by either party by giving a notice of seven days without assigning any reason. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates called for the interview. Selected candidates must submit an undertaking that he/she is not working at any Government or private health care facility at the time of joining and will not work during tenure.

faq.question: Q1. What is LBS Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: LBS Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 is a walk-in interview recruitment process to fill 2 vacant posts of Senior Residents in Obs & Gynae on an ad-hoc basis for 44 days.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in LBS Hospital Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Senior Resident position in the Obs & Gynae department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for LBS Hospital Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 9 October 2026, with reporting time between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with a Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognized institute with valid DMC registration. Candidates with MBBS and 2 years of experience may be considered if PG candidates are unavailable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for LBS Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the interview?
faq.answer: There is no fee for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Administration Branch, Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital, Khichripur, Delhi - 110091.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive pay under 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,008,700) along with other admissible allowances per month.
